meta.name: company-intel
meta.description: Research a company, industry, or competitor set using web search and seven analytical lenses. Use when you need structured intel that feeds downstream PM skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用七个分析维度研究公司、行业或竞品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要结构化商业情报
copy.tagline_en: Research companies, industries, or competitors with seven analytical lenses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured business intelligence before product decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过七个分析视角（财务、市场、产品、竞争、趋势、产品管理、战略信号）研究公司、行业或竞争对手，输出结构化报告，可被其他技能用于生成竞争卡、SWOT 等。
howto.when: 当你要求研究某家公司、行业或竞争对手集，或提供公司名加“竞争对手”时触发。也支持输入网址。

say.text: 研究一下 Helix Motion 公司。
say.note: Claude 会输出该公司的完整分析报告。

say.text: 比较公司 A、公司 B 和公司 C。
say.note: Claude 会逐一分析并给出跨公司对比。

say.text: 帮我查查 Figma 的竞争对手。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude researches a company, industry, or competitor set using seven analytical lenses (financial, market, product, competition, trends, PM, strategic signals) and outputs a structured report that other skills can consume for battlecards, SWOT, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to research a specific company, industry, or competitor set, or when you provide a company name plus "competitors." URLs are also supported.

say_en.note: Claude will output a full analysis report for that company.

say_en.text: Compare Company A, Company B, and Company C.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze each and provide a cross-company comparison.
